# 短报告：Michelson Interferometer（文风正例样例，仅用于 lint 自测）

## Abstract

The wavelength of a He-Ne laser was measured with a Michelson interferometer. Mirror displacement was read to 0.01 mm, and fringe counts were recorded at five positions. A least-squares fit of displacement against fringe order gives 632.6 ± 0.4 nm, which agrees with the 632.8 nm reference value.

## Results

The interferometer was levelled and the mirrors were aligned until a single central fringe remained. Fringe counts at five displacements are listed in the data table of the appendix. The fitted slope is 1.2663, with a residual spread below 2 counts. A 0.4° tilt of the movable mirror accounts for the 0.2% deviation of the fitted wavelength. The largest single-run drift is 1.8%, recorded while the room was warming up. Excluding that run changes the mean by less than the quoted uncertainty.

## Discussion

The residual 0.4° tilt suggests the plate holder was not seated flat. Two observers counted fringes independently and differed by at most one count in ten, so the counting uncertainty contributes 0.6 nm to the result. The 0.2% excess in wavelength may come from the plate thickness tolerance. The plate tilt and the counting spread together account for most of the residual scatter.

## Conclusion

The measured wavelength, 632.6 ± 0.4 nm, agrees with the 632.8 nm reference value to within the quoted uncertainty. Fringe counting, not the length reading, dominates the final uncertainty.
